description: Adds a motion graphic written as code (a Canvas 2D draw function, run per frame in Clypmint's sandbox): counters, charts, maps, labels, reveals, anything drawn. Read get_guide graphics first. The same name replaces it. Saved on its own. Saves a new version, all or nothing; restore_version undoes it. Cost: Free: no credits.

base_version.description: The version_id you read; refused if the video changed since. Left out: the live version, and a repeat is saved once.

code.description: JavaScript defining function draw(ctx, t, d, s) and optionally setup(d). Read get_guide graphics first.

end.description: Film second it ends; at most 30 s after start.

name.description: A short name; the graphic id is made from it (the same name replaces that graphic).

operation_id.description: The same id on a retry runs it once; a new id is a new request.

output_id.description: A Short, hook or shape of the video; the main video when left out.

slots.description: Words and numbers the code reads as d.slots, so they can be changed without new code.

name: write_graphic

outputSchema.description: Clypmint write_graphic result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Write a motion graphic
